title: Cherry Blossom Sunset Panorama
description: Panorama of a cherry blossom forest at sunset with some mountains in the distance and dripstone caves below.
body:
Panorama of a cherry blossom forest at sunset with some mountains in the distance and dripstone caves below.

The shader used is [I Like Vanilla](https://modrinth.com/shader/i-like-vanilla). Seed is **1290181510**. Panorama made for version 26.1.2, though it should work on any versions after.

![Panorama in game.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ac39f84eeba90632cc89a2a98cd209f4dfc131f7.png)
